app.name: Payments Ledger
app.summary: Record app-level receipt notes against r-cash accounts without rebuilding payments.

uniqueValue: A local receipt-note ledger that references r-cash account-factory accounts; payments and accounts are reused.

components.whyUnique: Receipt notes tied to an app ledger are not a registered primitive; accounts and transfers are r-cash's surface.
invariants: a note is appended by the ledger owner only

conservation.assertion: notes reference accounts; the app does not mint or move value

concurrency.risk: two operators append the same note
concurrency.mechanism: the linear ledger cell takes and reposts once per append

acceptance.then: the note is visible and the ledger remains open
